issues.description: setuptools<82 cap leaked into core/setup.py affects all downstream users, not just CI
issues.detail: Adding `setuptools<82` to core/setup.py install_requires/extras propagates a CI-only workaround into every published install. setuptools is a build tool; pinning it system-wide forces downgrades and risks solver conflicts in user environments unrelated to the mmcv bug. The cap belongs in CI scripts only.

issues.description: mmdet bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 without justification in a CI-fix PR
issues.detail: The PR is scoped to fixing mmengine/setuptools, but silently upgrades mmdet a minor version. This expands the change surface and may introduce behavioral or API differences in downstream multimodal/detection code paths. Either revert to 3.2.0 or document why 3.3.0 is required.

issues.description: mmcv installed with --no-build-isolation depends on ambient env state
issues.detail: Switching from `mim install` to `pip install --no-build-isolation` means mmcv builds against whatever torch, setuptools, ninja, and numpy are already in the env. If workflow ordering changes or the CI image drifts, builds may silently fail or compile against the wrong torch ABI. Document the required pre-installed state or pin build deps explicitly.

issues.description: Install order: mmcv before mmengine may cause transitive version churn
issues.detail: mmcv 2.1.0 requires mmengine at runtime. Installing mmcv first lets pip pull mmengine transitively, then the explicit `mmengine==0.10.7` install may downgrade or upgrade it mid-script. Installing mmengine first follows OpenMMLab's documented order and avoids version churn.

issues.description: FIXME comments lack owner, removal trigger, and core/setup.py has no comment at all
issues.detail: Three locations pin setuptools<82 referencing mmcv issue 3325, but core/setup.py has no FIXME, and the shell FIXMEs lack an owner or removal condition. When upstream fixes the issue, this cap will likely linger across releases. Add a comment in core/setup.py and an explicit removal trigger (e.g. mmcv >=2.2).

issues.description: mmengine switched from git SHA to PyPI 0.10.7 without confirming torch 2.5 fix is included
issues.detail: The previous install pinned a specific mmengine git commit chosen for a torch 2.5 compatibility fix. Switching to PyPI 0.10.7 should be verified to contain that same fix; otherwise the original bug the git pin solved may regress silently.

synthesis.summary: The panel unanimously identifies three P1 issues: the setuptools<82 cap was incorrectly added to core/setup.py install_requires (leaking a CI workaround to all end users), mmdet was silently bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 in a PR scoped to fixing mmengine, and the new `pip install --no-build-isolation` mmcv install depends on ambient env state (torch, setuptools) that may drift. Secondary concerns are install order (mmcv before mmengine), missing FIXME tracking in core/setup.py, and unverified torch 2.5 compatibility in mmengine 0.10.7. The fix should be scoped to CI scripts only, with mmdet reverted or justified.
